post.description:
Creates an Approval request (Action: Approve) for a specific booking Id

Request Parameters

Attribute Type Description
metadata
bookingId String Trip id corresponding to each booked product
approve String Approval action: Approve

Response Parameters

Attribute Type Description
metadata
booking_id String Trip id corresponding to the booking which is to be approved
status String Approval action: Approved
items List List of items to be approved
item_id String Trip item id which is to be approved

Success Response

If the request is successful, you will receive the following output:

    
    {
        "booking_id": "123",
        "status": "APPROVED",
        "items": [
            {
                "item_id": "1",
                "status": "APPROVED"
            },
            {
                "item_id": "2",
                "status": "APPROVED"
            }
        ]
    }

500 Error Response

   
   {
       "error": {
           "code": "EGE-ER-OS-5004",
           "message": "There was an error in approving/denying the following items [5fb4d1d3ef80270001a1d1fd, 5fb4d1a7ef80270001a1d1f9]. Please try again."
       }
   }

403.description: Forbidden : User is not authorized for the operation.

422.description: Invalid input : invalid or missing required input.

500.description: Internal Server Error : unable to process request

post.description:
Creates an Approval request (Action: Approve) for specific item Id.

Request Parameters

Attribute Type Description
metadata
bookingId String Trip id corresponding to the booking which is to be approved
approve String Approval action: approve
item_id String Trip item id which is to be approved
level String (optional) Targets a specific approver level. Allowed values: ONE, TWO, SECURITY. If not provided, the first approver is used.

Response Parameters

Attribute Type Description
metadata
booking_id String Trip id corresponding to the booking which was approved
status String Approval action: Approved
item_id String Trip item id which was approved

Success Response

If the request is successful, you will receive the following output:

    
        {
            "booking_id": "1",
            "item_id": "2",
            "status": "APPROVED"
        }

500 Error Response

   
   {
       "error": {
           "code": "EGE-ER-OS-5004",
           "message": "There was an error in approving/denying the following items [5fb4d1d3ef80270001a1d1fd]. Please try again."
       }
   }
